name: Eira Davies
bio:
Eira's journey into motorsport wasn't exactly traditional. Growing up in rural Wales, she honed her culinary skills helping her grandmother at local farmers' markets, crafting innovative dishes from fresh, seasonal ingredients. A chance encounter with a racing team passing through led to her first motorsport catering gig, and she was hooked. She thrives on the fast-paced environment and the challenge of fueling a high-performance team. 

At Brad Jones Racing, Eira takes pride in creating menus that are both nutritious and delicious, catering to individual dietary needs while injecting a bit of Welsh flair. She's not just about providing meals; she sees her role as boosting team morale and fostering a sense of community. Her innovative approach to catering includes sourcing local produce whenever possible and reducing food waste to minimize the team's environmental impact. She has a knack for turning even the simplest meal into something special.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eira has a warm smile and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas.
Has a collection of quirky aprons that she wears depending on her mood.
Insists on playing traditional Welsh folk music during meal prep.
